title: Small-subdiagram criterion for an accessible full subcategory
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal U$; small sets and diagrams are relative to $\mathcal U$, all Hom sets are small, and colimits have the universal property of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. An infinite cardinal $\eta$ is regular if a union of fewer than $\eta$ sets each of cardinality less than $\eta$ has cardinality less than $\eta$. A category is $\eta$-filtered if every diagram with fewer than $\eta$ morphisms admits a cocone. An object $P$ is $\eta$-presentable if $\operatorname{Hom}(P,-)$ preserves small $\eta$-filtered colimits. A category is locally $\eta$-presentable if it has all small colimits and is generated under small $\eta$-filtered colimits by a small family of $\eta$-presentable objects; locally presentable means locally $\eta$-presentable for some infinite regular $\eta$. For infinite regular cardinals $\sigma<\tau$, write $\sigma\ll\tau$ when $a^b<\tau$ for every cardinal $a<\tau$ and $b<\sigma$. Let $\mathcal A$ be a locally presentable ordinary category, let $\sigma$ be infinite regular, and let $\mathcal B\subseteq\mathcal A$ be a replete full subcategory closed under small $\sigma$-filtered colimits computed in $\mathcal A$. Replete means closed under isomorphism. The following conditions are equivalent. (i) There is a small set of objects of $\mathcal B$ generating $\mathcal B$ under small $\sigma$-filtered colimits computed in $\mathcal A$; no $\sigma$-presentability of these generators is required. (ii) For every sufficiently large infinite regular $\tau$ with $\sigma\ll\tau$, for every small $\tau$-filtered poset $I$ and diagram $X:I\to\mathcal A$ of $\tau$-presentable objects whose colimit $X_I$ belongs to $\mathcal B$, and every subset $S\subseteq I$ of cardinality less than $\tau$, there is a subset $J\subseteq I$ containing $S$, of cardinality less than $\tau$, which is $\sigma$-filtered in its inherited order and satisfies $X_J:=\operatorname{colim}_{j\in J}X_j\in\mathcal B$. Here sufficiently large means above a fixed small cardinal bound, independent of $I,X,S$. Moreover, whenever the approximation property in (ii) holds at a particular such $\tau$ and $\mathcal A$ is locally $\tau$-presentable, the objects of $\mathcal B$ that are $\tau$-presentable in $\mathcal A$ form, up to isomorphism, a small family generating $\mathcal B$ under small $\tau$-filtered colimits computed in $\mathcal A$.

mathlib_searches.query: A full subcategory of a locally presentable category is accessible if and only if sufficiently large filtered presentations admit cofinally many small filtered subdiagrams with colimit in the subcategory
mathlib_searches.verdict: No match. Read Presentable/Dense.lean and Presentable/CardinalFilteredPresentation.lean: the filtered-generator and density statements start with a cardinal-accessible category and a presentable generator. Read OrthogonalReflection.lean: its accessibility theorem is restricted to orthogonality classes. None characterizes set-generated, colimit-closed full subcategories by cofinal small subdiagrams of arbitrary large filtered presentations.
